in_marathi.name: Shivram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Shiva is the god of destruction and transformation, while Ram is an incarnation of Lord Vishnu. This name represents the union of both deities, symbolizing the power to destroy old patterns and transform into a new, stronger self.
